test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In which of the following places the Indian National Congress passed the resolution of Purna Swaraj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The resolution of **Purna Swaraj** or complete independence was passed by the Indian National Congress at the **Lahore Session** in December 1929.
 
• This session was presided over by **Jawaharlal Nehru**, who was a prominent leader in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• The declaration of Purna Swaraj was a significant moment in India's struggle for independence from British rule.
 
• Following this resolution, the Indian National Congress called for the celebration of **Independence Day on January 26, 1930**.
 
• This date later became the day when the Constitution of India came into effect in 1950, marking the Republic Day of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Lahore Session** of 1929 was a turning point in the Indian independence movement, as it marked a clear break from the earlier demand for Dominion Status to a complete demand for independence.
 
• The Indian National Congress, established in 1885, played a crucial role in the Indian freedom struggle, with leaders like Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, and Subhas Chandra Bose leading various movements and campaigns.
 
• The Lahore Session also saw the adoption of the tricolor as the national flag of India.
 
• After the declaration of Purna Swaraj, the civil disobedience movement gained momentum, further intensifying the struggle for freedom.
